# ALDI Source Snapshot

Official repository: https://github.com/zfnWong/ALDI

The initial `git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none` was interrupted because
the upstream repository includes large data files. The source files in this
directory were then downloaded from the official `main` branch raw URLs on
2026-05-14. The observed upstream HEAD during the partial clone was:

```text
87f9fe3 initial commit
```

Only code and README files are vendored here; upstream dataset artifacts are
intentionally not included.
